reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Senior secured loan of up to EUR 3mn (or USD equivalent) to TBC Leasing to support investment financing for micro, small and medium sized enterprises ("MSMEs") in Georgi, and promote EU standards in the market under the Eastern Partnership SME Competitiveness ("EaP SMEC") Programme for sustainable investments in technology and equipment. The project will enable the Company to finance medium to long-term investments of Georgian MSMEs in upgrading their technology and equipment necessary to meet EU standards in terms of product quality, health and safety measures and environmental protection.
